about: Product listing search. Three versions of the same rule. `${S}` is the schema (bench_listing locally; a real read-only DEV mapping is a copy of this file with its own SQL). Inputs: model?, brands?[], colour?, quality?, partType?, inStock?, page?, pageSize?. Output: skus[] ordered by rank_score DESC, sku ASC.

naive.about: What an analyst builds today: one lookup per question (devices, compatible products, products, stock), joined, filtered, sorted and paged in a function step.

config.query: SELECT device_id FROM ${S}.devices WHERE {{ (model ?? '') != '' or len(brands ?? []) > 0 ? 1 : 0 }} = 1 AND ({{ model ?? '' }} = '' OR model_name = {{ model ?? '' }}) AND ({{ len(brands ?? []) }} = 0 OR brand IN ({{ len(brands ?? []) == 0 ? [''] : brands }}))
SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM ${S}.compatibility WHERE device_id IN ({{ len(devices.rows) == 0 ? [-1] : map(devices.rows, #.device_id) }})

SELECT product_id, sku, rank_score FROM ${S}.products WHERE status = 'active' AND ({{ colour ?? '' }} = '' OR colour = {{ colour ?? '' }}) AND ({{ quality ?? '' }} = '' OR quality = {{ quality ?? '' }}) AND ({{ partType ?? '' }} = '' OR part_type = {{ partType ?? '' }})
SELECT product_id FROM ${S}.inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING {{ inStock ?? false ? 1 : 0 }} = 1 AND SUM(qty) > 0

single_today.about: One query with today's syntax: optional filters as `({{ x ?? '' }} = '' OR col = {{ x ?? '' }})`, the device and stock questions as sub-queries, ORDER BY + LIMIT in the database. StarRocks cannot bind LIMIT/OFFSET, so paging is impossible here: page 0, 24 rows only.

config.query: SELECT p.sku FROM ${S}.products p WHERE p.status = 'active' AND ({{ colour ?? '' }} = '' OR p.colour = {{ colour ?? '' }}) AND ({{ quality ?? '' }} = '' OR p.quality = {{ quality ?? '' }}) AND ({{ partType ?? '' }} = '' OR p.part_type = {{ partType ?? '' }}) AND ({{ (model ?? '') == '' and len(brands ?? []) == 0 ? 1 : 0 }} = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${S}.compatibility c JOIN ${S}.devices d ON d.device_id = c.device_id WHERE c.product_id = p.product_id AND ({{ model ?? '' }} = '' OR d.model_name = {{ model ?? '' }}) AND ({{ len(brands ?? []) }} = 0 OR d.brand IN ({{ len(brands ?? []) == 0 ? [''] : brands }})))) AND ({{ inStock ?? false ? 1 : 0 }} = 0 OR p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM ${S}.inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(qty) > 0)) ORDER BY p.rank_score DESC, p.sku LIMIT 24

single_new.about: One query with the new template syntax: `{{#if guard}} … {{/if}}` drops a filter the request does not ask for, LIMIT/OFFSET take a checked whole number. Every value is still a bound parameter.
